name: UniqueSplat
definition: A view-conditioned 3D Gaussian Splatting method that uses a hypernetwork to generate dynamic Gaussian parameters (center, opacity, covariance, color) conditioned on the query view, addressing the limitation of feed-forward methods that generate fixed Gaussians across all views.
summary: UniqueSplat is a feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting method that generates dynamic Gaussian parameters conditioned on the query view using a dual-branch hypernetwork.
